title: StateChange doc comment still says "Contact" after rename
description: crates/kith-core/src/events.rs line 12: struct doc says 'e.g. "Contact", "Chat", "Message"'. The type name was renamed to "ChatContact" in this commit but the canonical doc-comment example was not updated. A developer checking the doc to learn valid type names will use the stale value "Contact" and produce events that the TypeFilter silently drops.
